## Before you start {.study}

- **What you need:** Word and Excel (desktop, web at `office.com`, or the
  phone apps), and your notes of lectures 1–15.
- **Time:** about 60 minutes. Work alone, at your own speed.
- **How it works:** do Steps 1–3 on this page. The practice quiz shows you
  what you know; the two labs repeat the main skills. Then do the **Tasks
  to submit**.
- **What you submit:** one Word file and one Excel file, on the university
  e-learning platform, before lecture 17.
- **Tip:** after each wrong answer, open the notes of that lecture and read
  the section again.

## Step 1 · The practice quiz {.study}

- The quiz has 14 questions in four parts: **Files**, **AI**, **Word** and
  **Excel**.
- Do **All** first. Then choose the part with the most wrong answers and do
  it again.
- Read the feedback after each answer: it says the rule in one sentence.
- Your score is only for you: nothing is saved or sent.

## Step 2 · Word practice: headings and contents {.study}

- Give each heading a **style** (Heading 1, Heading 2).
- Insert the contents: **References › Table of Contents**.
- After a change, click **Update Table**.
- Page numbers: **Insert › Page Number** (in the header or footer).

![Heading styles (lecture 7).](../week-04/images/styles.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="../week-04/sims/toc-builder.html" poster="../week-04/sims/toc-builder.png" title="Contents Builder: headings, contents, update" height="620" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Word"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="bold text|Insert › Picture"}
What does Word use to build the contents?
:   the heading styles

Where do you insert the contents?
:   References › Table of Contents

You added a heading. What do you click?
:   Update Table

Where do page numbers go?
:   in the header or the footer
:::
:::

## Step 3 · Excel practice: formulas and references {.study}

- A formula starts with **=**: `=B2*C2`.
- Copy it down with the **fill handle**: B2 becomes B3, B4 …
- A **$** keeps a reference: `=B2*$F$1` keeps F1 in every row.
- Totals: `=SUM(C2:C6)`; then a chart with a title.

![Relative and absolute references (lecture 11).](../week-06/images/references.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="../week-06/sims/reference-lab.html" poster="../week-06/sims/reference-lab.png" title="Reference Lab: copy a formula with $" height="520" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Excel"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="=B2\*F2|48"}
B2 = 6, C2 = 7. What does =B2\*C2 show?
:   42

You copy =B2\*\$F\$1 from C2 to C5. What is in C5?
:   =B5\*\$F\$1

Which part stays the same when you copy =B2\*\$F\$1?
:   \$F\$1

What does the fill handle do?
:   it copies the formula down
:::
:::

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

Do the tasks alone. Your teacher marks them (6 marks).

### Task 1 · A short Word report (2 marks)

1. Write a one-page report "My first half of Digital Skills": a title and
   three headings (Heading 1): *Files*, *AI*, *Office*.
2. Under each heading, write two sentences about one thing you learned.
3. Add a table of contents and page numbers in the footer. Save it as
   `review_report.docx`.

### Task 2 · An Excel price list (2 marks)

1. Type five items and their prices (made up), and a tax rate of 16 % in F1.
2. In column C, make the price with tax with one formula using `$F$1`,
   copied down; add the total with SUM.
3. Make a column chart of the prices with a title. Save it as
   `review_prices.xlsx`.

### Task 3 · Short answers (2 marks)

a) Write the formula in your cell C4 and say why its F1 did not change.

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Which part of the practice quiz was the hardest for you? Which lecture
will you read again?

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## How to submit

Upload `review_report.docx`, `review_prices.xlsx` and your answers to Task 3
to the university e-learning platform, **before lecture 17**.
